files.README.md:
# Quillfen Analytics - stream-ingest configuration

`stream-ingest` receives event batches from customer SDKs and forwards them to tenant warehouses.

Two config layers apply: config/stream-ingest.yaml is the production instance config and config/stream-base.yaml is the platform baseline. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the baseline. A key in neither layer has no value at all.

All config changes reach the service through the deploy pipeline.
files.config/stream-ingest.yaml:
service: stream-ingest
environment: production
listen_port: 9220
shard_count: 6
# egress_throttle_mb_s: 1.5   # temporary headroom during the March incident, never ratified
log_level: info
files.config/stream-base.yaml:
tenant_tier: enterprise
listen_port: 8080
shard_count: 3
backfill_window_h: 72
log_level: warn
